Team: The team the player belongs to
Position: The player's position (e.g., QB, RB, WR, TE, DST)
Salary: The player's DraftKings salary for that week
ProjectedFPTS: Projected fantasy points for the week
Name: Player's full name
ActualDrafted: Actual ownership percentage — how often the player was drafted in contest entries (e.g., '12.46%'). Use this column for ownership queries.
ActualFPTS: Actual fantasy points scored in that week
ProjectedFPTS_Rank: Rank based on projected fantasy points for the position/week (lower is better)
ActualFPTS_Rank: Rank based on actual fantasy points scored for the position/week (lower is better)
AdjustedFPTS: Adjusted fantasy points after bias correction
BiasApplied: Bias correction applied to fantasy points
